description_en: A woven bucket chair on a wood-and-metal swivel column above a circular bamboo-clad base; the front shows the scooped seat, the side shows the cantilevered shell and hidden pivot shroud, and the rear reveals the rounded woven shell and base connection. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
